nom: COSRX One Step Original Blemish Pore Clear Pad

avis.texte: It feels very refreshing, and I can see it wiping something away from my face even when I've not worn any makeup or gotten messy, so I know it's doing its job! I'm breaking out less, and hopefully soon I won't break out at all.
I have extremely sensitive, dry skin that is very prone to irritation and ingrown hairs. This product has been a perfect daily exfoliator for my problem areas!

avis.titre: Effective but drying for already dry skin
avis.texte: I am finding this a little harsh for my very dry and sensitive skin. My skin barrier is currently a little wrecked and not tolerating many things. Using it more along the jaw line and upper shoulders has been working better for me than my face. The packaging is great and the product is huge, much bigger than the picture led me to think.

avis.titre: Clear Skin Made Easy with COSRX One Step Pads
avis.texte: The COSRX blemish toner pad is a quick and easy exfoliating toner pad that helps clear pores, reduce blackheads, and control oil. It gently smooths skin using BHA and leaves it feeling clean and refreshed. Best for oily and acne-prone skin, but may be too strong for sensitive skin if used daily.

These pads are a total game-changer! I was a bit nervous about trying a new chemical exfoliant, but they are incredibly gentle and did not break me out at all. After just a few uses I could clearly see the glow returning to my skin. They leave my face feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed without any irritation, definitely a new holy grail in my routine. . !!And and I was shocked by the size of the packaging :grin::joy:

I bought these for my sons who are in their teens and dealing with some breakouts but also sensitive skin. They both really like these pads. Their clean their skin without being harsh or stripping. I would recommend them to

Toner was always the 'missing step' in my routine because of the hassle. Fortunately, these pads make integration so effortless that I'll never skip it again.The container is a good size with 100 pads that'll last a while. Good design too as it comes with plastic tweezers that stay on the bottom of the top cover.So far it's a little early to tell, but I can tell right away that after my skin dries it looks more even in color. I imagine with times my pores will get smaller.

I am a very big fan of these pads! I got these while I've been in the midst of my skin being fussy. I do still have some acne after using these fairly regularly for a while (worked up to once every day or two), but I haven't been having the painful break outs I usually do. I am pleased with the results and how my skin's been feeling since using them. Photo is after I used these for 3 weeks and right after my most recent use to show how it sits on the skin! :)Pros:-Very nice for when I'm having a lazy day and don't want to do a full routine, my skin feels clean still-My skin looks very glowy and still feels very moisturized, the pad doesn't strip my skin or dry it out-Very easy to use tweezers and get the pads out, they're fairly easy to separate (those with mobility issues may have trouble but I don't know for sure, I do not so I can't speak on that!)-I haven't noticed any problems using this under makeup and find my foundation sits well over it (I don't use primer)-Lots of product on pad which is awesome, I never worry I'll need more of the liquid on the pad while using one-Also good to use in routine when I need to feel extra clean, sometimes the pad even catches more stuff that the facewash didn'tCons:-There is a pretty strong smell from it. It doesn't bother me too much personally and I find it goes away after a bit of time on the skin, but if that's something that turns you away, you may want to know-Take your time using these as early on (and being eager to get this as

I have not used toner pads in many years but I have, obviously, been missing out! I have combination sensitive skin so I used the pads as a once weekly exfoliant and I was so happy to see this random dermatitis pimple go down so quickly. These pads are great for breakouts, they aren't drying and they fit perfecting into my regimen.

I like the this Blemish Clear Pad. It's super convenient and easy to use, and I've noticed my skin looks smoother after consistent use. It helps keep breakouts under control without feeling too harsh or drying for my face. Definitely a great addition to my routine.

I am currently dealing with hormonal acne due to menopause and a household member on hormone-suppressing medication as part of cancer treatment ("Period syncing??. After using the product for several days I observed a reduction of the severity of the acne. My skin was not as red and bumpy. It appeared less congested and smoother, and the pimples started to dry up. The product is easy to use and incorporate into my daily routine.

I have been using these pads for almost 2 weeks now and It has not caused any new issues with my face yet I think it is too soon if it's causing any improvement for my pores or blemishes/acne. These sorts of products take some time to show their efficacy so I will continue using them for now. What I can say is that there is some tingling to the skin (I tend to be sensitive, but it does fade) and it's quite scented; the closest comparison I can make is the aroma of tea tree oil. The container is rather large and takes up some significant real estate on my sink; there is quite the gap between the container and the stack of pads inside so I wonder if maybe the packaging could use some updates.

I love the idea of this product. I have oily skin and hate how dirty my pores always look. Unfortunately, I have a lot of skin allergies and this product is not hypoallergenic and fragrance free like so many of the CosRX products are. I would love if CosRX came out with an aha/bha product for sensitive skin.

I wasn't sure what to expect when I received this, but I ended up loving it! The two sided pads are really nice and made my face feel and look amazing. My skin looks clearer and my pores look and feel tighter. I will continue to buy this product when I use up my free trial. I love it like most Cosrx products!

I really like this. As someone with sensitive skin, I need products that don't flare me up. This wasn't drying or overly scented. Light fragrance without being cloying. I use this at night before bed to give it time to work.

I very much enjoyed this product! I feel it helped smooth texture and kept me looking a little extra clean! The ingredients are great having BHA + PHA + Zinc PCA + Pantothenic Acid + Allantoin and Hyaluronic Acid. I absolutely LOVE the container it's durable and it comes with tweezers which is great so you aren't sticking your hands in.

I really like the packaging of this product. Especially the built-in tweezers, which are super convenient and feel more hygienic. So far, it's been helping with small breakouts and cleaning out my pores. My skin feels really clean and kind of glowy after using it. I've only been using it for a short time, but my skin seems to be handling it really well. I'll definitely recommend giving it a try!

avis.titre: Comparable to Medicube Zero Pore Pad
avis.texte: I'm basically comparing this to the Medicube Zero pad. These pads are bigger with more pads in the jar, tightly packed with the lid go keep them from drying up. I like the tweezers for hygienic purposes when taking each pad out like Medicube but I prefer Medicube's as it's easier to handle. It doesn't sting my face but I do have sensitive skin, so I can only use it 2-3 times a week as it can cause some redness on my cheeks. I'm not a fan of the strong herbal scent (tea tree oil?) but it did leave my skin glowing.

I wanted to try this properly before writing a review. This project is everything it says it is. My pores do appear cleaner and smaller and it doesn't dry up my skin. I haven't had to use any physical exfoliation because the texture of my skin feels nice and soft.

avis.titre: These toner pads are a staple in my routine. They
avis.texte: I love how the COSRX One Step Original Clear Pad gently exfoliates and helps keep my pores clear without irritating my skin. It leaves my face feeling smooth, refreshed, and balanced. The only minor downside is that the pads are a bit thin, so you might need two for full coverage, and the mild herbal scent isn't for everyone.

To start off, I have very oily acne prone skin. I also have very large pores and was hoping it would help. Now I don't see any change in my pores, I did notice my skin feel smoother immediately. I started off using every 3 days twice and now every other day. I did notice my breakouts were more controlled. I will continue to use. Now I have to say I love the packaging. The lid is easy to open and has a spot for the tweezers to hang onto which is super helpful.

Fun, reusable packaging that keeps the pads nice and damp and I really liked the tweezers to get them out. The texture on the pads really helps with exfoliation. The scent is very earthy and the moisture dissipates quickly, leaving my skin feeling fresh. I've already seen results in oil balance across my face. The ingredients don't dry out my skin which is rare for a cleanser pad.

I had the opportunity to be an exclusive Mystery Glow Trialists for this product. I happened to be experiencing a hormonal breakout when I received it and was happy that it seemed to help soothe my skin. This product didn't irritate or dry out my skin. I tried it on its own and while I did feel a little shiny after my ski felt moisturized, The tweezers help me feel like I'm ensuring cleanliness when using this product. Overall I am happy with this. The container is a little large so it't not great for traveling but a good at home care skin care routine addition.

I already use the One Step Original Clear Pads, but I think that way better than those! I have decently oily skin, but using these in morning keeps the shine away for a long time without drying my skin out- probably from the hyaluronic acid. Using these consistently for a week and a half have definitely kept my pores clearer than they usually are. I haven't had nearly as many white heads popping up well, so I think these can replace another product I'm using for that, too. I think over the next month the results will be even better. The pads also have some kind of floral/fruity scent that I like, but I think it's light enough to not be very noticable when you're using them. The pads themselves are bigger than the old ones, which I like more for swiping across my face. The container went through a huge redesign and is also about twice as big as the current One Step pad container. It's really nice looking, but I hope they will sell refill packs without having to get a whole new container each time. The tweezers got moved sticking to the top of the lid, and are nice and secure up there.Overall, I love these and I can't wait to get more when I'm done with my old clear pads.

I have sensitive skin and most products for acne tend to irritate and sting my skin, so i was skeptical about even trying these. These did not irritate my skin at all in any way. The size of the product is awesome and the pads are huge! I love that the pads are very saturated and not dry like some other toner pads i have tried in the past. The tweezers being kept inside securely to the top of the lid is genius, i wish more companies did this! These also don't dry out my skin either like i thought they might. Very happy i got to try these! They will come in handy expecially in the summer to help refresh my skin. Super quick, and easy to use!

This product packs an impressive list of ingredients that can address several skin concerns at once. My skin concerns are breakouts, texture, and blemishes like acne scars. After the first use, I noticed that the texture on my nose was slightly better, and my skin felt smoother. After using this product every other night for just over two weeks, I am quite impressed with the results. My skin is brighter, somewhat smoother, and some of the blemishes are already beginning to fade. Other things to note:- The container is bold and fun looking, but it is also rather large and takes up quite a bit of space. The large size of the pads explains the packaging size, though.- The pads have a nice texture that doesn't feel rough when swiping it over my face. The solution soaked into the pad feels cool and soothing going on, though when I patted the excess with my hands, it did leave a slightly tacky-feeling residue on my hands.Overall, I'm really happy with this product, and plan to keep it as an official part of my routine!

avis.titre: Still Exploring but Wonderful So Far
avis.texte: When I opened my package, I loved the container that these came in. I was hoping for good things to come. I have been using these every night since I got them. I love how soft and smooth my face feels and looks after I use the pad. I start with the embossed side and then use the smoother side. I have seen an improvement of my skin in the first week. My skin was having a major break out and these pads have helped to calm my face and start healing the blemishes. I love these and am looking forward to what the rest of the weeks look like with my face.

Right now I'm struggling with break outs and not happy overall with my skin texture so these came at a great time. Instead of having to mix different products containing individual ingredients, this one step pad is so simple. I love the packaging, looks very clean and the built in tweezers make accessibility even easier. I was stunned by how much excess dirt and oil I was able to remove. Definitely worth purchasing!

I've been using the product for one week now my skin looks and feels clear. Pores are shrinking less visible texture is improving uneven tone fading. It's gentle with a light, clean, barely noticeable scent. The rough texture side gives you a deep exfoliation the un textured side gives you a more refined exfoliation. My skin feels soft, fresh, clean, and hydrated after using.

After trying this product after years of using the COSRX Original Clear Pad, I noticed several meaningful differences that may matter depending on what you're looking for.Pad Size: Each pad is slightly larger—about 0. 7 mm bigger than the Original Clear Pad.Packaging & Storage: The container itself isn't bigger, but the lid is noticeably wider. This might sound minor, but it actually affects where you can store it. If you keep your skincare in a bathroom mirror cabinet, the wider lid may prevent the door from closing properly.Scent: This product has a more pleasant scent. If you're sensitive to smells or just prefer something fresher, this is a nice upgrade.Effectiveness: Results show up faster for acne caused by bacteria. I noticed visible improvement after the first use, which is impressive. However, if your breakouts are hormonal, this formula doesn't seem to make much of a difference.Quantity: You get 10 more pads than the usual quantity, which adds a little value.Bottom Line: This is a great option if you want slightly larger pads, a nicer scent, and quicker results for bacterial acne. Just keep in mind the wider lid if you rely on compact storage, and don't expect major improvements for hormonal breakouts.

I've been using these pads for about a week and it cleared up a small breakout on my chin. Usually, whenever I have breakouts I use pimple patches at night and clean the area well in the morning. I started using one pad in the morning to replace my toner and my breakouts has been going away. I also like the tweezers it came with, it makes it easy to get one pad.

This toner pad was definitely a winner. Application was easy and they even provided a lil tool to pick up the pad. I applied it to my face and neck, leaving my skin glowing and feeling clean. I would definitely recommend giving it a try.

I absolutely love how my skin looks after using this product. I've used it twice a day for about a week and my skin has such a glow to it I've never noticed before. The container is HUGE and I love that it comes with tweezers to peel off the pads. They have a nice scent to them & don't leave too much residue.

After a week of use, my pores do look smaller. My face feels clean after use without being dry. Love the smell of these blemish pads, too. They don't smell bad like other brands. I would recommend these to anyone having issues with blemishes and blackheads.

This product is amazing! The container is huge and the rounds are really big too! You get a ton of product and it feels great on the skin! The look of the container is really cool and they don't break easily.

avis.titre: New Take On An Older Product
avis.texte: I got this product for free. I have hormonal acne and sensitive skin, so I it is difficult to find products that work for me. I didn't know what the product before I received it. I am already other potent acne medications, I was too scared to incorporate another active into my routine. However, I did that the ingredients included a lot of calming ingredients - very different from other versions of this product. I decided to use this product on my chest and back to help with my body acne. This could be a great product for people on the go who need something quick and hassle-free. Also, I even find using them on my bikini area prevents ingrown hairs and irritation. The tub is quite big and once I empty it, I will probably use it to store cotton rounds. Overall, great product!

I got this as a surprise sample from the company to review, and so far I really like it. I have sensitive skin that likes to overreact and I also have a lot of allergies, so the first day I got this product all I did was patch testing in both my inner elbow and my inner wrist. When the whole day passed without reaction, I added it into my morning routine in place of my usual toner (which is also a Cosrx product of a different line).It's been three days and I do think my skin texture looks more even and glowy. I have rosacea so I don't want to go around looking like a tomato, but if anything, I have that dewy complexion without looking and feeling oily. The pad has a nice exfoliating texture on one side, but it's not too harsh. I feel like I can use it every morning and not dry out my skin. It also comes with these nifty tweezers. There is a little bit of a fragrance, but it fades quickly. Overall, I would consider adding this into my routine permanently.
I'm very surprised with the pads. I don't really have acne anymore so I'll use them to take care of any blackheads on my nose. You can use this if you have only skin.

I was really impressed by these little guys! I've used other blemish pads in the past, which have felt harsh and drying, and only moderately improved my skin. These pads, on the other hand, are really gentle on the skin and leave you feeling hydrated and refreshed. But they also do a great job with clearing skin. After less than a week, they cleared a few breakouts that were in progress or just about to start, without leaving me dry or flaky. The packaging is also great, with an easy-open cap and built-in storage for the included tweezers.

I am really loving this new product! I have very sensitive skin that reacts badly to many ingredients, it makes it difficult to achieve that smooth, beautiful, glass skin we all want. THIS product has helped give me that gift. It is working perfectly for me. No break outs, no skin irritation + easy to use after i wash my face. It smells nice, feels nice when applied+ gives a fresh shiny appearance after use. I really do love this stuff + am happily using it each am/pm with noticeable results. Thank you Cosrx, you've made my 46yr old skin very pleased!

avis.titre: Works Well for Sensitive, Allergy-Prone Skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and a lot of allergies, so I'm always very careful about what I put on my face. One of the things I really appreciate about these pads is the ingredient list, it feels simple, thoughtful, and not overloaded with things that tend to irritate my skin.The pads themselves are gentle but still effective. They leave my skin feeling clean, balanced, and refreshed without that tight or stripped feeling some exfoliating products can cause. Instead, my skin feels soft, comfortable, and lightly moisturized after using them.I also like how easy they are to use as a quick step in my routine. They help smooth the skin and give it a nice refreshed feeling without causing irritation, which is important for someone with sensitive skin like mine.Overall, this has been a really pleasant product to use and something I would feel comfortable keeping in my regular rooutine.

I received this and tried it right away. I like the scent! It left my skin feeling fresh. I had a few breakouts on my chin when I started using this. They are clearing up after a couple of days and my skin isn't dried out or peeling.

I rarely break out but when I do, it is difficult to get it under control because my skin reacts to so many products. These blemish pads have been AMAZING!! First off, there are tweezers inside the lid so it makes grabbing them easy and I'm not touching all over multiple pads which rocks. There is a textured side and a smooth side to each pad. I used the textured side on the areas that had blemishes and the smooth side on the rest of my face and neck. I had like 8 pimple patches on my face at one point but after using these pads for 5 mornings and evenings in a row after washing my face with the Cosrx snail mucin gel cleanser, my skin is almost completely clear! No irritation, no break outs, no new redness (I do have rosacea), no painful dryness, it's actually very impressive!!

avis.titre: Better than the original (though I miss Mr. CosRx
avis.texte: I used these way back in the day and absolutely loved them. The container is certainly larger than the old one and these pads are soaked! Such a delight and incredibly useful for handling whiteheads

I have enlarged pores and I was searching for a product to take care of them. This Clear Pads one of those I will consider and continue to use to see results. For now I use it about 3-4 days and after each application my skin looks so clean and smooth. Even after hydrophilic oil it's now that clear.
